include_directories(BEFORE Common)

add_definitions(
   -DNDIS51_MINIPORT
   -DNDIS_MINIPORT_DRIVER)

# netkvm.inf is NOT staged: every ID it lists (virtio-net 1AF4:1000 and 1AF4:1041) is
# driven directly by netstack.sys, which does not sit above NDIS yet (M11 in
# docs/engineering/smoltcp-netstack-design.md). With the INF on the media, setup bound
# this miniport to the NIC under netstack, reset the device, and netstack's
# synchronous virtqueue wait spun forever, wedging the boot. Re-add it with M11.
# add_driver_inf(netkvm netkvm.inf)

# netkvm.sys is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/netkvm-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(netkvm_shims OBJECT Common/ParaNdis-Common.c Common/ParaNdis-Oid.c Common/ParaNdis-VirtIO.c Common/ParaNdis-Debug.c Common/sw-offload.c wxp/ParaNdis5-Driver.c wxp/ParaNdis5-Impl.c wxp/ParaNdis5-Oid.c)
target_link_libraries(netkvm_shims PRIVATE virtio libndis libntoskrnl libhal)
if(NOT MSVC)
    target_compile_options(netkvm_shims PRIVATE
            -Wno-unused-function
            -Wno-pointer-sign
            -Wno-pointer-to-int-cast
            -Wno-int-to-pointer-cast
            -Wno-attributes)
endif()
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")
    target_compile_options(netkvm_shims PRIVATE -Wno-old-style-declaration -Wno-unused-but-set-variable)
endif()
add_cargo_module(netkvm netkvm-cargo netkvm.sys
    KIND kernelmodedriver
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/drivers
    EXTRA_DEPENDS netkvm_shims psdk bugcodes xdk)
